stage: PRE-REGISTERED step-matched control for the hard-panel transformer null: pairs80 at base_lr 3e-3 sized to ~60k optimizer steps, the regime in which the transformer is known to transition on easy48
one_arm_rationale: Transformer-only by design. The candidate's pairs80 crossing is already sealed (campaign m 10/16, campaign ag 16/16, both at 3e15 = 1/16 of this budget). A concurrent candidate arm would double wall-clock from ~13h to ~26h to re-answer a settled question. The control is historical and named, not implied; this campaign produces no paired statistic and none is claimed.
base_lr: 3e-3 (harness default in train.py -- deliberately NOT overridden)
why_this_matters: Separates 'attention needs more compute' from 'attention needs more optimizer steps than matched-FLOPs buys it on a 320-token panel'. Preprint v0.4.2 limitation 11 names this as the decisive missing control and states we have not run it.
step_budget_derivation: pairs80 @ 4.8e16 measured 21,797 A-phase steps at ~1.6h/run. Steps scale linearly with budget at fixed panel/batch, so 1.32e17 = 4.8e16 x 2.75 -> ~59,900 steps at ~4.4h/run. ax observed the easy48 transformer transition between step 40,528 and 60,792, so this cell spans that window.
coverage_hole_also_closed: The corpus's LR x budget coverage is two marginal lines, not a grid: 4.8e16 ran only at base_lr {1e-4, 3e-4}, and 3e-3 was never run above 1.2e16 on pairs80. This cell is exactly that untested corner.

preregistered_gate.transitions_eq_0_means: NULL_SURVIVES_STEP_MATCH -- the hard-panel transformer null holds at ~60k steps at the one learning rate known to work elsewhere. Preprint limitation 11 can be discharged rather than merely disclosed, and the hard-panel claim becomes substantially harder to attack.
preregistered_gate.transitions_ge_1_means: NULL_IS_STEP_BOUNDED -- the hard-panel result is at least partly an optimization-time bound rather than a pure compute threshold. This is a significant qualification of the paper's transformer claim and MUST be reported as such. It does not touch the window-provisioning law or the component matrix.
preregistered_gate.no_efficacy_stopping: All 6 seeds run to budget exhaustion regardless of what the first ones show. No early stop, no seed added after the fact.
